TS5101: `baseUrl` goes away in TypeScript 7

  TypeScript 6 deprecated this option, and TypeScript 7 (the native type checker) refuses it.

  Fix: Delete `baseUrl` from tsconfig.json and start each `paths` target with `./` (relative to tsconfig.json). A bare import that only `baseUrl` resolved needs an entry in deno.json `imports`.

  Original (deno check):
  │ TS5101 [ERROR]: Option 'baseUrl' is deprecated and will stop functioning in TypeScript 7.0. Specify compilerOption '"ignoreDeprecations": "6.0"' to silence this error.
  │   Visit https://aka.ms/ts6 for migration information.

error: Type checking failed.
